summary: This is a corrective re-merge of the hierarchical BoQ breakdown-%/interim-billing/retention feature (PR #596) that fixes a real audit finding: interim/RA bills previously posted with $0 GST because no taxTemplateId was ever set on invoice lines, and a negative 'Retention held' invoice line was additionally shrinking the taxable subtotal. The fix makes taxTemplateId a required, validated input on generateInterimBill, adds a pure buildInterimBillInvoiceItems() helper that carries the real tax template onto every invoice line and stops emitting the negative retention line (retention now stays purely a holdback tracked on constructionInterimBills.retentionAmount/netPayable, separate from the invoice), and extracts a pure computeInvoiceTaxTotals() out of erp-invoicing-service.ts's computeInvoiceTotals() for independent unit testing. Verified by direct reading of the current repo state (not just the diff/self-report): construction-valuation-service.ts, erp-invoicing-service.ts, construction-boq-service.ts, the import route/service, and both interim-bills API routes all call requireAuth(), scope queries by orgId, and use withTenantContext/RLS consistently with the rest of the codebase. The new migration (drizzle/0267_construction_boq_hierarchy_interim_billing.sql) is purely additive (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS), matches the existing 0101_wave115 RLS pattern for both a direct-org_id policy and an EXISTS-join policy on the child line-items table, and its migration number/journal entry are internally consistent at HEAD (already renumbered 0265->0267 to resolve a real collision with concurrently-merged Helpdesk/PM/HR migrations). New tests directly target the fixed behavior (no negative retention line, every item carries the real taxTemplateId, tax computed on the undiminished gross) and read as genuine regression tests, not rubber-stamp assertions. No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff. Two things correctly remain open and are honestly disclosed rather than hidden: the migration has not yet been applied to the live Supabase project, and get_advisors(security) has not been run post-migration -- both correctly deferred to human sign-off given tier2, not attempted by the worker.
issues: Migration not yet applied to the live Supabase project and get_advisors(security) has not been run against it -- must happen before/at merge, per this task's own disclosure and tier2 status.

Minor, non-blocking: constructionInterimBills has no status/cancellation field, so if the linked erp_sales_invoice is later cancelled via cancelSalesInvoice(), the interim bill's currentBillAmount still counts toward previousBilledAmountsByLineItem on the next interim bill -- an edge case out of this task's stated scope, not a regression it introduced, but worth a follow-up gap entry.

Minor, non-blocking: bill numbering uses a read-then-insert max(billNumber)+1 pattern (construction-valuation-service.ts) with a theoretical race under concurrent interim-bill generation for the same project -- explicitly flagged by the worker as a pre-existing convention (matches erpSalesInvoices.invoiceNumber) intentionally left untouched, not a new issue.
